name: Live Template Results
changes: The Pro notice for the results panel now has a Sponsor on GitHub button.
tip: Click a result, or move the cursor into it, to see and edit its Templater command.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Live Template Results is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for keeping it in your editor.

related.name: Shortcuts Bridge
